newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Africa bank plans broad help for private firms.
newsitem.headline: Africa bank plans broad help for private firms.

text.p: The head of the African Development Bank (AfDB) said on Tuesday it planned to work to alleviate poverty in Africa by targeting investment to private companies and improving the environment in which they operate.

Bank President Omar Kabbaj told Ivorian businessmen that this was part of a new five-pronged strategy adopted by the bank, adding that it was aimed to stimulate national and international private investment.
"It goes without saying that nothing interesting for Africa will happen without economic growth," he told the information meeting in Ivory Coast's commercial capital Abidjan.
"The first area that this new strategy will deal with is the creation of an environment favorable to the development of business," he said.

He listed others as direct injection of capital into profitable projects in the private sector, private financing of infrastructure in African states, aiding privatisation and development of small and medium-sized firms.
